Use case: infographic-diagram. Produce a polished scientific paper illustration, landscape approximately 2.2:1, high resolution. The input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its professional pastel blue/code, pale green/language, peach/evidence, lavender/log color system, navy outlines, large clean English sans-serif labels, small elegant flat icons inside generous rounded rectangular cards. Pure white background, no texture, no shadows, no 3D, no decorative border. The reference's arrows and wording are NOT scientific authority. Rebuild the exact supplied updated topology. Every label must be spelled perfectly, no paragraphs, no invented quantitative data. Balanced aligned grid, ample separation, all arrows clearly routed with no crossings through text.
Title: "Controlled directed evolution". Subtitle: "GB1: five roles and an auditable selection loop". Upper horizontal row, left to right: "Measured data" (small chart icon); "Data Analyst" (chart and magnifier icon); "Hypothesis Generator" (lightbulb icon); "Mutation Designer" (four residue tiles icon, not five); "Fitness Evaluator" (prediction chart icon); "Scientific Critic" (checklist icon). Solid arrows connect this upper row left to right. Analyst, Designer and Evaluator blue. Hypothesis pale green, small badge "Optional LLM". Critic pale green, small subtitle "Rules + optional notes". Lower row below Evaluator extending leftwards: "Batch selector" with small label "Mean / UCB + BLOSUM", then to its LEFT "Freeze batch" (snowflake icon), then LEFT "Oracle lookup" (database magnifier icon), then LEFT "Update data" (database refresh icon). A solid arrow goes DIRECTLY from Fitness Evaluator downward into Batch selector. Solid arrows from Batch selector to Freeze batch to Oracle lookup to Update data (flow right to left). Update data loops back into Measured data. Scientific Critic connects ONLY by dashed arrow to a bottom lavender horizontal "Event log" bar. It must NOT connect to Batch selector or Freeze batch by any solid arrow: critic verdicts are logged but the frozen GB1 consumer selects all scored candidates. Other role cards may have clean dashed logging lines to Event log. Tiny legend "Solid: executed flow" and "Dashed: logging". No prior rules floating box. No misleading critic-to-selection edge. Keep chart icons purely symbolic. All title and card labels are mandatory.

Top row left to right: "Nominated prediction" (small prediction chart, subtitle "Before measurement"), "Oracle observation" (database magnifier, subtitle "Measured fitness"), "Residual record" (paired document icon, subtitle "Observed - predicted"). Arrows left to right. It must not end at or point to the legend, and it must not be a solid edge to any selector. Keep the legend legible and separate. All other solid and dashed edges unchanged.
